thread:
Asha (Growth): Quick sync: webinar + benchmark launch this Thursday. Need a tight SEO playbook today: keywords, JSON-LD for Event+FAQ, internal linking anchors across launch posts, and a redirects + canonical map for the gated benchmark PDF. Can we lock by EOD?
Ben (SEO): I'll own keywords + schema. Primary targets: "inference benchmark" and "LLM inference cost benchmarks". 4 supporting longtails incoming.
Marta (Content): Internal linking plan: add 1 contextual link per launch post to /benchmark-summary using anchor text variations: "benchmark results", "benchmark overview", and "benchmark findings" to avoid exact-match overuse. Add homepage CTA to webinar register.
Ravi (Infra): Prefer gated PDF under /assets/downloads/benchmark-2026.pdf for stable slug. Will add 301s and X-Robots-Tag: noindex, follow on that response.
Ben (SEO): Minimal FAQ JSON-LD for summary page (drop in head):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What metrics are included?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Latency, throughput, and cost across model/quantization configs."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I download raw data?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Full report is gated; summary and key charts are public."}}]}
```
Ben (SEO): Event JSON-LD stub (replace ISO dates):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Benchmark Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-06T17:00:00Z","description":"Live walkthrough of results + live Q&A","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar/register"}}
```
Ravi (Infra): Redirects I'll add (nginx-style):
```
# launch redirects
rewrite ^/benchmark$ /benchmark-summary permanent;
rewrite ^/benchmark/pdf$ /assets/downloads/benchmark-2026.pdf permanent;
rewrite ^/webinar$ /webinar/register?utm=launch permanent;
```
Ravi (Infra): Curl smoke tests to include in PR: 
```
curl -sI https://redwood.example.com/benchmark | head -n 5
curl -sI https://redwood.example.com/benchmark/pdf | grep -i X-Robots-Tag
```
Marta (Content): Canonical rules: summary page canonical -> /benchmark-summary. For multi-page launch series use rel=prev/next; if duplication persists canonicalize series pages to page 1. Also OG/Twitter meta should point to summary (og:url canonicalized).
Ben (SEO): Add a small redirect CSV for devs: source_url,target_url,status_code,notes. Example row: /benchmark,/benchmark-summary,301,summary landing.
DeployBot: scheduled: link-scan and meta-audit at 06:30 UTC tomorrow; will DM failures.
Asha (Growth): Deliverables by EOD: Ben -> keyword list + JSON-LD file; Marta -> list of posts + anchor text to update; Ravi -> redirects CSV + curl tests; I'll finalize email CTAs and social copy.
Marta (Content): I'll also tighten meta descriptions to 140-155 chars and ensure unique H1s across the series.
Ben (SEO): One more: watch trailing slash normalization (redirects should canonicalize to no-trailing-slash for landing pages). Add test for /benchmark/ -> 301 to /benchmark-summary.
Ravi (Infra): Noted. I'll include tests for trailing slash, query params, and 301/302 drift in the deploy checklist.
Asha (Growth): Thanks team, will sign off once CSV + snippets are in the shared drive :white_check_mark:
